agent_mcp.reason: This is a static bundle; a public MCP facade requires an application host. The network definition itself is public and can be loaded by any conforming browser runtime.

networks.description: Find free public APIs for any goal, call them live from your browser, and get a cited, verified summary of what came back.
networks.name: open_api_scout
sample_queries: I need weather data for Jakarta. Which free API should I use, and what is the current temperature?
Find recent research papers about ocean microplastics and summarize the top results.
Compare the population and capital of Indonesia and Japan using live data.
What were the strongest earthquakes in the past week?

peer_policy.note: Peer networks are loaded only when the visitor pastes a peer URL and approves the consent card. No peer origin is contacted by default.
